author: Mike Hanks
title: NCC students to present spring plays - NewsBreak
text:
By Mike Hanks ,
17 hours ago Normandale Community College in Bloomington will present two theater productions to conclude its 2025-26 season.
Productions of “The Play that Goes Wrong” and “A Murder is Announced” begin this weekend in the Premanand Fine Arts Theatre of the college, 9700 France Ave.
“The Play that Goes Wrong” is set during the opening night of the Cornley University Drama Society’s newest production, “The Murder at Haversham Manor,” where things are quickly going from bad to utterly disastrous. Accident-prone thespians battle against all odds to make it through to their final curtain call.
“A Murder is Announced” features an announcement in a local paper stating the time and place when a murder is to occur in Miss Blacklock's Victorian house. The victim is not one of the house’s several occupants, but an unexpected and unknown visitor.
“The Play that Goes Wrong” will open 7:30 p.m. Thursday, April 2, with additional performances 7:30 p.m. Saturday, April 4 and Friday, April 10. A matinee performance is 2 p.m. Saturday, April 11.
“A Murder is Announced” will open 7:30 p.m. Friday, April 3, with additional performances at 2 p.m. Saturday, April 4, 7:30 p.m. Thursday, April 9, and 7:30 p.m. Saturday, April 11.
Adult admission is $10. Senior, staff and student tickets are $5. Tickets may be reserved online or by calling 952-358-8884.
